work.
body: Products we designed and built with the teams who run them.

items.title: Perfect Electro Lines
items.body: A product site for power equipment — generators, UPS, substations, and the systems around them, built for desktop and phone.
items.imageAlt: Perfect Electro Lines on a laptop and phone: a product map of generators, UPS, substations, and related power equipment.

items.title: EduSync
items.body: A campus platform for student records, fees, and the daily work of a school — from the staff dashboard to family sign-in.
items.imageAlt: EduSync on a laptop and tablet: a school dashboard with student and balance totals beside a sign-in screen.

items.title: Astha Trip
items.body: Travel agents and service providers on one platform — tour packages, visa applications, guest documents, and the services around a trip.
items.imageAlt: Astha Trip on a tablet and laptop: a dark travel platform with the headline Plan. Book. Travel.
